searchText: is there a document to follow on voluntarily 'EXIT' from validating? You send a VoluntaryExit message That's basically all that you need to do If in epoc 'e' validator signs an exit, then in epoc 'e+1' (subsequent epoc) it will not be considered to be a part of the committee? No, the validator enters a new state of exiting once the voluntary exit operation is included on the chain, but the time between exiting and exited depends on various factors (most notably the exit queue). The operation and subsequent behaviour are documented in the consensus specs.
